headlines.text: Rewind to 2024, when the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Swerve Strickland vs. Roderick Strong went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.54 ? a well-worked match. It was the 50th time the AEW World Heavyweight Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Strickland retained his AEW World Title over Strong, who fought through a bad knee before falling to a second House Call, confirming Strickland's spot in the Forbidden Door main event.
